headline: Every fruit cup checked, not a sample.
label: #FFF6E0
heroLede: With several fruit cup varieties on near-identical cups, checking seals, labels and best-before codes by eye takes your team's time. Here's what a camera check could look like on your fruit cup line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks that every cup is sealed, that the lid sits flat and that the film has not lifted at the edge. A poor seal on a fruit cup turns into a leaking four-pack on a supermarket shelf.
labelLede: Apple puree and apple and pear puree look almost the same in the cup. The camera checks every cup carries the right label for the run, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fruit cups sit in lunchboxes and pantries for months, so the best-before and batch code has to be right and readable. The system reads the printed code on every cup and compares it with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Fruit prep brings stems, stones and packaging offcuts close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there and stops it reaching a case.

vocab.alert: Four lifted seals in fifteen minutes on Line 1. Check the cup sealer.

extra: 'Wrong label: Apple on a Apple Pear run'
'Wrong label: Apple puree on an Apple and pear run'
